FAQs
items.html:
Can I buy a single flavor once I discover my favorite?
Absolutely! Once you know which flavor your family loves most, feel free to purchase it individually—or explore it in our ortho toothpastes, ortho flosses, or ortho mouth sprays, too.
What makes SuperMouth’s Orthodontic Mouthwash different from regular mouthwash?
SuperMouth’s Orthodontic Mouthwash is specially formulated for individuals with braces, aligners or other orthodontic devices. It’s alcohol-free, contains no antiseptics or harsh essential oils, and is enriched with prebiotics like inulin to support a healthy oral microbiome. It also features an alkaline pH of 8.5 and our unique Hydroxamin complex (nano-hydroxyapatite at ideal concentration plus vitamins D3 & K2) along with fluoride to help strengthen enamel and protect against cavities and decalcifications.
Can children and adults both use this mouthwash?
Yes, our Orthodontic Mouthwash is designed for both children and adults undergoing orthodontic treatment. It offers the same high level of protection and care for users of all ages, making it a versatile choice for families.
At what age can children start using SuperMouth’s Orthodontic Mouthwash?
Children can start using our Orthodontic Mouthwash at age 6, when their swallowing reflexes are fully developed. It’s generally not recommended for children younger than 6 due to the risk of swallowing.
What other orthodontic products does SuperMouth offer?
SuperMouth offers a range of orthodontic products designed to complement your oral care routine, including Orthodontic Toothpaste, orthodontic-specific toothbrushes (manual and electric), and OrthoFloss with threaders. These products work together to ensure comprehensive care during orthodontic treatment.
How is SuperMouth’s Orthodontic Mouthwash different from other similar products?
Our mouthwash is designed specifically for orthodontic care, containing no artificial flavors, colors, sweeteners, or preservatives. It’s packed with prebiotics to support a healthy oral microbiome and features our proprietary Hydroxamin complex, which works with fluoride to strengthen enamel and help prevent cavities and decalcifications.
Can I purchase SuperMouth’s orthodontic products as part of a system?
Yes, SuperMouth offers orthodontic care systems with options like Basic, Plus, and Complete. The Basic system includes Orthodontic Toothpaste, a specialized toothbrush (electric and manual options available), and OrthoFloss with built-in threaders. The Plus system adds a mouth spray and tongue cleaner, while the Complete system includes everything in the Plus package along with our Orthodontic Mouthwash for comprehensive oral care.

items.title: HOW TO USE
items.html:
• Shake well before each use.
  • Measure out 10 ml of mouthwash.
  • Swish vigorously for 1 minute, ensuring it reaches all areas around brackets and wires.
  • Spit out—do not rinse with water, so fluoride and nano-hydroxyapatite can continue working.
  • For best results, use first thing in the morning and last thing at night before bedtime.
